# NOD News

> Danny Cares presents news he somewhat cares about. Daily negotiation news, real estate signal feed, and NOD brand content.

## What it is
- Daily news feed on negotiation, FBI-style tactics, real estate deals
- Signal feed dashboard of curated content
- Brand site for NOD (Daniel Cruz's content ecosystem)
